scope: Exact project-authored temporal examples; no package or bank execution

calendar_dependence.warning: Rows sharing a calendar shock are not ten independent units.

dynamic_intervention.meaning: Surgical intervention is defined on the supplied transition model; it does not validate the model.

regime_shift.stationarity_required: A pooled lag is not a single structural effect when regimes differ.

temporal_method_limits.transfer_entropy: Predictive information from source past to target future conditional on target/conditioning histories; embedding and surrogate law must be specified.
temporal_method_limits.cross_mapping: Library-size prediction/correlation under an embedding; direction and common drivers need separate scrutiny.
temporal_method_limits.var_lingam: VAR plus DirectLiNGAM under non-Gaussian independent disturbances and acyclic instantaneous structure; thresholds and sample warnings are not calibration.
temporal_method_limits.dbn_intervention: BNT mutilates a supplied DBN by clamping nodes and removing incoming arcs; model construction and parameter validity precede intervention.
